title: Deeper/broader associative graph semantics, DXF adapter loss, and peer-boundary reconciliation
mode: Primary-source documentation, current peer issue review, and local source audit
scope: Compare associative-object semantics documented by Autodesk with the generic DXF OBJECTS contract and local DXF/DWG callback routes.
Determine whether the concrete dwg2dxf adapter retains and emits associative DXF records captured by the library parser.
Reconcile current open-source peer evidence without duplicating already-owned local hardening, EED, units, codepage, object, and XDATA work.
Update PAR-06 and add implementation-ready 7BV steps while preserving independent/native qualification boundaries and existing fast-test cadence.

local_source_files_inspected: src/libdxfrw.cpp: associative DXF dispatch and dxfRW::processAssociativeObject() capture/callback sequence
src/drw_objects.h: DRW_AssociativeObject partial shell and class-specific fields
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp: dx_iface::addRawDxfObject() allow-list and addUnsupportedObject() DWG frame handling
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h: concrete callback and OBJECTS output routes
dwg2dxf/dx_data.h: concrete adapter-owned object categories and absence of an associative raw container
tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp and tests/CMakeLists.txt: existing adapter test executable and focused selectors

local_source_audit: The DXF reader's processAssociativeObject() constructs DRW_AssociativeObject, captures and validates a full DRW_RawDxfObject, then invokes addAssociativeObject() followed by addRawDxfObject().

The concrete dx_iface does not override addAssociativeObject(). Its addRawDxfObject() stores only enumerated families; ACDBASSOC-family and PERSUBENTMGR records have no matching category in dx_data and fall through.
The adapter has no associative-family serializer loop. The low-level generic writeRawDxfObject() facility exists, but source search found no dx_iface call site for this family.
The DWG path is separate: reader callbacks carry DWG object/frame representations and cannot be replayed through the DXF raw-group writer.
No runtime parser→adapter→writer reproduction was run; the local conclusion is source-confirmed only.
peer_issue_reconciliation: ACadSharp #1281's recursion shapes are already represented by generated repeated-DXF-record hardening controls; peer counts are not adopted as format limits.
ACadSharp #1282's signed EED-size overflow shape maps to existing exact-size EED boundary coverage; no peer limit is copied.
ACadRust #125, #131, and #132 map to existing oblique-angle, codepage, unknown-object/color, and table-XDATA owners; no duplicate work item is added.
ACadRust #135 leaves a persistent-subentity layout as a hypothesis without a public drawing; no parser grammar is inferred.

OpenCADStudio discussion #1117 describes a self-round-tripping application graph but no AutoCAD/BricsCAD open validation and an omitted dependency-chain DXF writer; it is not independent semantic acceptance.
method.limitations: Autodesk ObjectARX pages document associative graph behavior, while the reviewed general DXF references provide common OBJECTS groups rather than complete class-specific ACDBASSOC DXF grammars. LibreDWG's public class/status disclosures are per-class maturity evidence, not normative format rules. No external drawing, local runtime reproducer, peer executable, native CAD application, or solver was used. The adapter omission is source-confirmed but its exact user-visible output behavior remains to be tested locally.

sources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX associative graph semantics
sources.observed: Constraint groups own constraint/proxy-geometry nodes and dependencies on geometric subentities, variables, and sometimes graphical dimension entities. Actions/networks represent ordered dependencies and evaluation updates dependent objects.
sources.evidence_ceiling: ObjectARX semantics and object relationships only; not a complete DXF tag grammar, DWG byte layout, or libdxfrw implementation result.

sources.name: Autodesk generic DXF OBJECTS contract
sources.observed: OBJECTS holds nongraphical records and is topologically ordered by ownership; common groups describe owner, reactors, extension dictionaries, and typed object-pointer/ownership roles.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Generic framing and common fields only; no class-specific associative grammar or guarantee that unknown tail fields are safely remappable.

sources.name: LibreDWG associative class registry and maturity disclosures
sources.observed: The peer enumerates many associative classes but assigns differing stability/coverage states; its manual identifies several as unstable, unhandled, or partially tested.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer inventory and maturity declaration; not a normative specification, runtime result, or independent semantic qualification.

sources.name: ezdxf associative and dimensional-constraint boundaries
sources.observed: ezdxf documents dimensional-constraint DIMENSION entities as unsupported and says it does not manage or verify associative HATCH links.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Specific DXF route limitations; not a result for all ACDBASSOC objects or for libdxfrw.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #135 and OpenCADStudio discussion #1117
sources.observed: #135 describes an unresolved persistent-subentity hypothesis without a public drawing. #1117 describes a limited application-side 2D graph build/self-roundtrip but lacks AutoCAD/BricsCAD open validation and says dependency-chain DXF output is omitted.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Issue/discussion evidence only; no normative grammar, independent round-trip, or native semantic result.

sources.name: Adjacent peer issue shapes already owned locally
sources.observed: Recursion, EED size, oblique-angle units, legacy codepage mapping, unknown custom objects/color names, and table XDATA reports were cross-checked against existing plan owners and controls.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Discovery and test-shape evidence only; no duplicate local defect or peer threshold is adopted.

assessment.existingFindingRefined: PAR-06; source-confirmed concrete DXF converter-adapter drop is now explicit
assessment.newTopLevelSubplan: 7BV associative DXF object capture and safe replay
assessment.planImpact: PAR-06 now names the source-confirmed DXF adapter silent-loss path. New 7BV begins with a generated callback/identity test and an atomic fail-closed output gate, proceeds to bounded per-import typed/raw retention, and admits same-profile raw replay only after class-specific references and owner closure can be proven. The DWG opaque-frame path, constraint solving, native evaluation, and support claims remain separate.
